Also check conditional cooperation: average contribution last round? Need compute average: round12 contributions sum: total_pool 6.468984375 multiplied? Baseline 80% =5.088, extra 30% =1.908, total 6.996 > wallet 6.36, so contribute full wallet 6.36. That overrides conserve? So cannot afford punishment (cost 3). So skip punish.

Thus actions: contribute full wallet 6.36, no broadcast. one action.
